title: Questionnaire Matchmaking
description: 4 captured saves. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: QUESTIONNAIRE MATCHMAKING SAVE01
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 17125; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.unavailableReason: Another recovered save; the site offers one selected player.
versions.startupSource:
0  LIST -999
10 CLEAR 2000
20 PRINT"RUNNING
DATA SHOULD BE OF FORM....
#QUESTIONS,#MALES,#FEMALES,A1M1,A2M2,...A1MM,A2MM..ANMM,A1F1...
25 READ QU,ML,FM:N=ML:IF FM>NTHEN N=FM
30 DIM P(N,N,1),PP(N),RJ(N),A(N,Q,1)
35 PRINT
40 PRINT"NOW SOMEONE MUST (SECRETLY) TELL ME WHO EVERYONE IS"
50 FORI=1TOFM:PRINT"WHO IS FEMALE #"I;:INPUT N$(I,1):NEXTI
60 FORI=1TOML:PRINT"WHO IS MALE #"I;:INPUT N$(I,0):NEXTI
70  INPUT"HOW MANY CORRECTIONS (0 FOR NONE)";C
